name: Iterable
description: Iterable is a cross-channel customer communication platform for email, SMS, push, in-app, commerce events, journeys, campaigns, experiments, and audience data.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated customer-owned server-side API key and exact US or EU data-center enum. Relay pins 39 current REST operations: 15 structural reads run directly, eight user/metrics reads and 16 engagement mutations require approval, and destructive administration plus exports/bulk transfer remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: ITERABLE_SERVER_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Iterable server-side API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated server-side key for the exact Iterable project; a read-only key is insufficient for manage tools.

credentialRequirements.name: ITERABLE_REGION
credentialRequirements.label: Iterable data center
credentialRequirements.helpText: Set to us for USDC or eu for EDC; Relay maps this enum to a fixed Iterable origin.

capabilities.label: Read users and metrics
capabilities.description: Use eight bounded user, event, membership, message, and metrics reads with approval.

capabilities.label: Manage engagement
capabilities.description: Use 16 event, commerce, user, subscription, message, cancellation, and journey mutations with approval.

allowed.label: Read Iterable structure
allowed.description: Read bounded campaign, channel, experiment, journey, list, message-type, snippet, template, field, and webhook metadata.

approvalRequired.label: Read Iterable users and metrics
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded campaign/experiment metrics and user, event, list-membership, and sent-message data.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Iterable engagement
approvalRequired.description: Track events and commerce, update users and subscriptions, send or cancel messages, and trigger journeys.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Server/client API keys, JWTs, authorization headers, and secrets never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Delete or forget data
blocked.description: User forgetting/deletion, catalog/list/template/metadata deletion, key management, and other destructive administration are not agent-facing.

blocked.label: Export or bulk-transfer data
blocked.description: CSV/JSON exports, export jobs/files, bulk user/event/template operations, and unbounded pagination are excluded.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only 39 pinned REST operations run on the configured US or EU origin; arbitrary paths, origins, headers, and query/body API keys are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Fifteen structural reads run directly; eight user/metrics reads and all 16 mutations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 39 selected and project-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; fixed data-center routing, bounds, audits, and secret/destructive/export blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts selected pinned Iterable tools, injects the encrypted project key server-side, and maps the stored region enum to a fixed US or EU origin.

providerSetup.blocker: Live acceptance requires a customer-owned Iterable project and dedicated server-side API key in its correct data center. No provider console, account, API key, JWT, consent, send, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a least-privilege staging key outside this worker, store the key and us/eu region in Railway staging, and verify project binding, safe and sensitive reads, approval denial/approval, event and consent behavior, each messaging channel, cancellation, journey trigger, pagination bounds, rate limits, key disable/delete, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Iterable documents TLS 1.2, Api-Key header authentication, separate fixed USDC and EDC base URLs, live interactive references, response handling, and endpoint-specific rate limits.
Iterable documents project/data-center-bound key types, server-side versus client-side permissions, read-only endpoint access, header-only API key use, and key disable/delete lifecycle.
The live USDC Swagger 2.0 document publishes 129 paths and the exact routes selected for Relay's 39-operation allowlist.
Iterable documents safe handling for invalid keys, insufficient privileges, validation, conflict, rate-limit, and provider failures.
